name: Bi-variational Physics-Informed Operator Network (BVPINO)
summary: Use locally weighted variational mechanisms for continuous coronary fractional-flow-reserve curve prediction.
core_idea: Weight neural basis learning and equation residual evaluation with variational functions carrying local stenosis information.
innovation: Specializes physics-informed operator learning to emphasize local stenosis patterns and FFR pullback gradients.
limitations: Clinical validation is limited to the evaluated angiography cohort and assumptions.
Cannot be treated as a general patient-specific PDE parameter-inference method without new tests.

start_here.why: Direct coronary-specific method and evaluation example.
start_here.focus: Local variational weighting and continuous FFR-curve evaluation.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
